articles.title: Cursor Confirms Malicious Claude Code Extension With SSH Backdoor Was Available for 11 Hours
articles.summary:
Cursor has confirmed that malicious Claude Code extension packages were available through its VS Code Extension Marketplace for roughly 11 hours on October 29, 2026. The altered packages targeted Windows and macOS users and attempted to install an SSH backdoor for lasting remote access. According to Cursor’s security notice, the affected versions were Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312 […]

articles.title: Over 60,000 Attacks Target WordPress RCE Vulnerability Within 24 Hours
articles.summary:
Hackers are targeting a WordPress Core remote code execution vulnerability that can expose websites during software updates. The supplied Wordfence threat intelligence snapshot lists 60,471 blocked attempts over 24 hours. These are attack attempts, not confirmed website compromises, and the figure does not establish how many individual sites were targeted. WordPress released version 7.1.4 on […]
